goal: Prepare schema/instructions so future /goal-style execution can iterate with original + space + model reasoning without full-log or provider-call bottlenecks.

hard_gates.fresh_space_reference_gate: Codex request only if unknown space refs may change judgment.
hard_gates.full_log_scan_gate: Default NO inside loop; use quick board and pointer descent.
hard_gates.gemini_gate: Hermes never direct; only Codex-side if Codex judges layer ambiguity.
hard_gates.provider_backed_call_gate: Default NO; require user approval and explicit budget reason.
hard_gates.write_namespace_gate: Hermes writes hermes_exec; Codex writes codex_space; shared_handoff for boards/pointers only.
